items.headline: Dan Carney, co‑founder of Pizza Hut, dies at 95, leaving a global pizza empire behind
items.summary: Carney, who helped turn a modest Kansas kitchen into the world’s largest pizza chain, passed away, prompting reflections on how his franchising model reshaped fast‑food dining worldwide.

items.headline: European Central Bank names Pablo Hernández de Cos as its next president amid leadership transition
items.summary: The appointment comes as ECB chief Christine Lagarde steps down, raising questions about the bloc’s monetary policy direction as inflation pressures persist.

sources.title: European Central Bank Chooses Pablo Hernández de Cos as Next President

deepDive.imageSearchQuery: Pablo Hernández de Cos ECB president appointment 2026
deepDive.caption: Pablo Hernández de Cos steps into the ECB's top chair as Christine Lagarde departs early, reshaping Europe’s monetary helm.
deepDive.biasLeft: Left‑leaning coverage frames the leadership shuffle as a test of the ECB’s democratic legitimacy, stressing how an abrupt exit could ripple through households facing rising living costs. It highlights the need for a president who will prioritize growth that benefits workers and guard against a technocratic echo chamber. The story also notes the board vacancies as an opening for more diverse, socially‑aware voices.

items.headline: UK agrees to pay an EU participation fee while US markets recover and American homeowners face higher mortgage costs
items.summary: New legal documents reveal Britain’s contribution to EU operating expenses, while a Treasury analysis shows many borrowers will see monthly mortgage payments rise by about £100, and SpaceX announced it will give a share of its stock to every active Trump‑linked account, adding a political‑finance twist as US equities recover after a steep intraday loss.
